pages.name: Alda
pages.section:
None | [NPC] Alda: Welcome to Abiphones & Co., <Username>![NPC] Alda: Are you here to buy an Abiphone?Select an option: [What's an Abiphone?]
Selecting [What's an Abiphone?] | [NPC] Alda: Have ya ever needed to talk to or buy something from an NPC, but they're on a different island?[NPC] Alda: And getting to them would take ages, even if you had a Travel Scroll?[NPC] Alda: That's where the Abiphone comes in![NPC] Alda: Simply add an NPC as a Contact and you can call them anytime, anywhere![NPC] Alda: Sounds amazing, right?Select an option: [I guess.]
Selecting [I guess.] | [NPC] Alda: Then why don't ya buy one? I'll do a little discount, just for you.
After buying Abiphone Basic | [NPC] Alda: Congratulations on becoming a proud owner of an Abiphone![NPC] Alda: Before you go, let me show you how to add a contact.[NPC] Alda: Simply hold the Abiphone in your hand, and click on an NPC![NPC] Alda: Why don't you try it out on me now?
Abiphone Contact | [NPC] Alda: ✆ Nice job![NPC] Alda: ✆ It's really as simple as that. I'll add myself to your Contacts now![NPC] Alda: ✆ One last thing - not every NPC owns an Abiphone, so you can't add everyone as a Contact.[NPC] Alda: ✆ To see who you can add, simply open up your phone and check the Contacts Directory.[NPC] Alda: ✆ That's it. Enjoy your purchase!

pages.name: Alixer
pages.section:
First Interaction | [NPC] Alixer: I'm here to help you with Bingo![NPC] Alixer: Come to me if you want some Potion Effects to help you in your journey![NPC] Alixer: I can give you better effects depending on your Bingo Level.
Granting Effects | [NPC] Alixer: Splish...BUFF! You have gained [potion effect]! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects![NPC] Alixer: Splash...BUFF! You have gained [potion effect]! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects![NPC] Alixer: Sploosh!BUFF! You have gained [potion effect]! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects![NPC] Alixer: Good Luck!!
On Cooldown | [NPC] Alixer: I gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!
Abiphone, fewer than 4 Bingo Goals | [NPC] Alixer: ✆ You want to have my number?[NPC] Alixer: ✆ I'd love to give you my number![NPC] Alixer: ✆ However, Bingo requests that you have completed at least 4 Bingo Goals before I can give you my number.
4 or more Bingo Goals | [NPC] Alixer: ✆ That's a bunch of Bingo Goals you've completed![NPC] Alixer: ✆ I'll gladly give you my number!
Calling | [NPC] Alixer: ✆ Hi! Did your potions run out?[NPC] Alixer: ✆ I'm not sure how well this works over the phone...[NPC] Alixer: ✆ Hold your phone close to your ear, I'll throw the potions into my phone.BUFF! You have gained [potion effect]! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects![NPC] Alixer: ✆ Wow![NPC] Alixer: ✆ Potions travel much faster by phone![NPC] Alixer: ✆ Good luck with the Bingo!
Calling, On Cooldown | [NPC] Alixer: ✆ I gave you potions recently! Give me some time to prepare new ones!

pages.name: Angler Angus
pages.section:
First interaction | [NPC] Angler Angus: Whenever you fish, make sure you're using some type of Bait.[NPC] Angler Angus: You can store Bait in your inventory or Fishing Bag, which is unlocked at Raw Cod Collection III.[NPC] Angler Angus: Bait is automatically consumed whenever you cast your rod, so it's easy to use![NPC] Angler Angus: I craft Fish Bait all the time because it's so easy to do - just a couple of Raw Cod and a Raw Salmon![NPC] Angler Angus: Here, I've got some spare Fish Bait for ya!
After claiming Fish Bait | [NPC] Angler Angus: Fish Bait seems to give a really effective ☂ Fishing Speed boost![NPC] Angler Angus: All Baits serve some specialized purpose, so be sure to keep some on you at all times![NPC] Angler Angus: If you have any questions about Bait, you can view my Bait Guide at any time![NPC] Angler Angus: You can also use /bait as a shortcut if you aren't feeling like paying me a visit!

pages.name: Apprentice
pages.section:
None | [NPC] Apprentice: The Furniture Shop has many different kinds of cool furniture for you to put in your world![NPC] Apprentice: For a price, you can buy it here!
[NPC] Apprentice: I'm still learning carpentry. I learn the most when crafting enchanted items!
Before Talking to Carpenter | [NPC] Apprentice: Talk to the Carpenter upstairs to learn more about Carpentry!
Before Giving Carpenter Wool | [NPC] Apprentice: Looking for wool? Try the Mushroom Desert!

pages.name: Bulvar
pages.section:
First Interaction | [NPC] Bulvar: Ever thought you'd see a Tier 12 Minion?[NPC] Bulvar: Well, today's your lucky day!
Abiphone Contact | [NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Hmm? My Abiphone Contact?[NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Well, today might just be your lucky day - again.[NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Abiphones ain't much use down here - you'll seldom get a signal, but I do own one.[NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Seeing as I'm feeling nice, I'll give you my contact for the small sum of one Silex.[NPC] Bulvar: ✆ How about it?[GIVE ITEM]
Without Silex | [NPC] Bulvar: ✆ I don't know what ya think that is, but it's not a Silex.[NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Come back once you've got yourself one.
Giving Silex | [NPC] Bulvar: ✆ That'll do it![NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Cheers friend, once I got that on my Drill I'll be mining like Divan![NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Oh, and before I forget - here's that contact you were asking for.[NPC] Bulvar: ✆ Give me a call in case you ever need some Tier XII Mining Minions.

pages.name: Carpenter
pages.section:
Village, First Interaction | [NPC] Carpenter: Hi, [player]! Welcome to the Furniture Shop.[NPC] Carpenter: Sales are too good right now, I can't keep up with the demand![NPC] Carpenter: Could you bring a stack of White Wool to help replenish my stock?[NPC] Carpenter: Sheep over in The Barn drop wool, but you can also purchase it from the Wool Weaver.[NPC] Carpenter: She lives in a house in the main plaza near the bank.
Without Wool | [NPC] Carpenter: Come back with a stack of White Wool!
Giving Wool | [NPC] Carpenter: Wow, thanks so much for the help![NPC] Carpenter: Carpentry is my passion, I always love to teach others.[NPC] Carpenter: Here's the recipe for the Carpentry Table. You can place it in your world and craft furniture that you've unlocked![NPC] Carpenter: You can now gain Carpentry XP by crafting items. Leveling your Carpentry Skill unlocks new furniture recipes![NPC] Carpenter: Some furniture is available exclusively in the Furniture Shop downstairs.
Check it out!
After Giving Wool | [NPC] Carpenter: Check out the Furniture Shop downstairs!
[NPC] Carpenter: The Furniture Shop is downstairs. Purchase cool furniture down there!
Garden, First Order | [NPC] Carpenter: Hey, <playername>. I found this blueprint laying around in my house, just collecting dust. Thought it might catch your interest.
Completing the first order | [NPC] Carpenter: Here you go! Hopefully, you'll make better use of it than I ever could.
Subsequent orders before building Greenhouse | [NPC] Carpenter: Hey, I noticed you haven't used that blueprint I gave to you. Did you lose it?[NPC] Carpenter: Luckily for you, I made a copy!
Completing the above order | [NPC] Carpenter: Here you go! Don't misplace it this time. It would've done just the same in my home.
Denying the above order | [NPC] Carpenter: No worries, I'll hang on to it for now. I'll come back later.
Greenhouse before Sam | [NPC] Carpenter: Ah, hello there! I have some information for you, but you need to finish talking to Sam first!
Greenhouse after Sam | [NPC] Carpenter: Looks like you could use some help with your Greenhouse.[NPC] Carpenter: Don't worry, I got you covered![NPC] Carpenter: Talk to me any time to see your Greenhouse mutation progression.
None | [NPC] Carpenter: Hey, how are you doing with the Greenhouse? That blueprint was complex.
Completing | [NPC] Carpenter: Thank you! I'll be checking in to see how you're doing with the Greenhouse.
Denying | [NPC] Carpenter: No worries, I'll come back later.
